items.name: init
items.title: YoRHa init
items.description: Project bootstrap for the YoRHa registry: pulls in @yorha/base and @yorha/utils and documents the app CSS cleanup a React Router template needs.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project. After adding @yorha/init: (1) in app/app.css delete the react-router template's unlayered `html, body { ... }` background and color-scheme rules. Unlayered rules beat the kit's @layer base, so the page keeps the template's white/dark background instead of the YoRHa panel colour. (2) Select a theme with the data-theme attribute on <html> (light | dark | authentic | high-contrast); density and motion use data-density and data-motion. Example: <html lang="ko" data-theme="light" data-motion="full">.
